name: Switch
summary: An on/off control: a checkbox with role="switch".

guidance.useFor: A setting that applies at once, on or off: notifications, dark mode.
insteadUse: A choice that applies when a form is submitted: Checkbox
A pressed state on a toolbar: Toggle button
content: The label names the setting, not the action ("Order updates by text")

rungReason: A checkbox with role="switch" keeps the native state, keyboard and form behaviour and announces on/off.

a11y.name: The <label> it sits in
a11y.targetSize: 48 × 28 px track; the label row is at least --lue-size-target-min

enhancements.fallback: Not used yet: appearance: none redraws it the same everywhere

motion: The thumb springs across (--lue-motion-ease-spring); instant under reduced motion
contrast: Increased contrast: a strong boundary and a solid ring when on
forcedColors: Field / FieldText; the thumb FieldText off, SelectedItemText on SelectedItem
